comment.comment:
“My full ZZZ thesis:

At a high-level, ZZZ is building what could be called a "multiplayer product factory". This means that through the ZZZ product, the vision is for teams/communities to be able to collaborate together on projects with AI embedded into the workflow AND responsible for the building.

Collaboration is core to human innovation. Our ability to communicate, problem solve, etc is the greatest productivity amplifier of all time. What if we offloaded all of the menial and "in-between" work to AI? What if AI could be responsible for all the rough edges and busy work required in a regular human-only team? Humans make all the decisions, agents help steer the conversation/optimize the workflows, and then agents do all of the work. 

X (ZZZ dev) was the lead GMX dev, a proven builder in this space with huge amounts of experience building in crypto. With AI being able to do most of the work now, what matters in a team is "execution", and it's hard to bet against someone's execution when they have a track record like his. 

Building in crypto is a distinct advantage because of table selection. Teams here are more likely to try new things, allowing the project to iterate quickly and scale with less competition than immediately building to target enterprise. But I do believe ZZZ will eventually be an enterprise revenue angle. Before that, revenue will come from membership subscriptions for communities, selling inference, etc.

As for token utility, it's going to be revenue buyback burn. People who complain they don't know what the token does are dumb and you should block them for not knowing how to read. 

The vision of the product is not easy to build, you're building a hugely complex state machine that needs to handle sensitive data all while agents are properly embedded inside the workflow. But if done right, this could be building the infra for the next innovation wave in how humans work on a day-to-day basis.”

~ Latenlinq

ZZZ is a multi-billion dollar product imo. Will be one of the few crypto protocols that make a breakthrough into tradfi, intertwining crypto with agentic AI.
